metadata.extracted_from: HTML person--inner-wrap cards (h2 = name, small = title, p = group/sector/location, background-image = headshot)
normalization: trailing '?' query params stripped from slugs
notes: groups = organizational bucket tags (Investment Staff / Operating Team / Value Creation / Fundraising and Investor Relations / Managing Directors).
sectors = sector or functional-department tags as listed; some cards carry only a sector tag and no group tag.
'Managing Directors' (MD) is a directory tag, not a rank; it co-occurs with IS or OT on some cards only.
Two distinct people share the name 'Michelle Xu' (slugs michelle-xu and michelle_xu).
2 records have no location; 13 records have no headshot.
has_photo=true means a headshot URL exists in source; exact image paths omitted here for payload size (available on request).
